integrity: The ordinary polynomial follows from a universal bipartite obstruction: any general position set of size at least three is independent, and in a crown graph any independent set of size at least three is one-sided. The general-2-position polynomial follows from an exact index-pair classification and agrees with the triangle-free dissociation equivalence from the foundational source. Direct exhaustive geodesic checks independently validate both polynomials and their discrepancy with the published T*(n,2) expression.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected crown graphs Cr_n with n at least three.
The correction concerns the T*(r,2) specialization only and does not reassess T*(r,a) for a different from two.
Finite exhaustive verification for 3 <= n <= 9 is corroborative only.
A later correction or erratum could exist outside the searched indexing and exact-phrase queries.
title: Correcting the general position polynomial of crown graphs
